channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DeMar DeRozan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DeMar DeRozan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Perry on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“I’ve been in the league 26 years, and (DeRozan) was one of my favorite players to work with,”

Scott Perry on DeMar DeRozan, Jul 9, 2026. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Julius Randle on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Ayo Dosunmu
item.description:
‪Michael Scotto‬:Julius Randle on Ayo Dosunmu:

“I didn't know he was that damn good. I ain't gonna lie to you. When I was in the East and he was in Chicago, that were those DeMar DeRozan and Zach LaVine teams, so I don’t know if the opportunity was there as much, but damn, I'm glad we got him.”

Julius Randle on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Ayo Dosunmu, Apr 26, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl
item.description:
Libaan Osman:Masai Ujiri on the Toronto Raptors getting the 9th pick in the 2025 NBA Draft:

“Tracy McGrady. DeMar DeRozan. Jakob Poeltl. We’ll be fine. I guarantee you we’ll be fine.”

Masai Ujiri on Tracy McGrady, DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl, May 12, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Kings interim head coach Doug Christie:

“Part of my job is to get the heck out of the way and let (Fox, Sabonis, DeRozan) do what they do.”

Doug Christie on DeMar DeRozan, Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Dec 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @MattGeorgeSAC.

item.title: Louis Williams on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“I was even hearing whispers that there was a situation where he might have asked or suggested that even DeMar DeRozan come off the bench.”

Louis Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Dec 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Powell said Wednesday night.

“Learning from when I was in Toronto with Kyle and DeMar (DeRozan), learning from Dame (Lillard) and CJ (McCollum), learning from PG and Kawhi. Being around those top guys and just getting game and knowledge from them in the summer. Going up against them, battling, and just wanting that.”

Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Nov 8, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Will Hardy on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“That’s a whole different thing to have to prepare for. Fox, Sabonis (and) the up-tempo style was already enough of a problem to gameplan for and prep your team for. “... I think (DeRozan is) a weapon for them. It’s like pitching in baseball. You can’t throw a fastball every pitch. I think having that change of pace with DeMar, a change in style, is going to be beneficial for them as they go throughout the season.”

Will Hardy on DeMar DeRozan, Oct 31, 2024. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“You’re coming in and you’re asked to do more. That’s with any job on the planet. When they pay you a little bit more, you’re asked to do a little bit more. For me it’s kind of walking in and leaning into it.“They’ve asked me to be more of a leader. I’ve been able to see how guys — obviously DeMar [DeRozan] — seen how he led. With Zach [LaVine], see how Vooch [Nikola Vucevic] leads. Early on it was Thad Young, Garrett Temple, you see the way they led. You pick up little things from them knowing that, and hoping that my time will come to lead, and that time has come. It’s a challenge for sure, something new, but I always try and lean into it.”

Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine, Oct 5, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Billy Donovan on DeMar DeRozan, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Julia Poe:Billy Donovan on how he valued the current Bulls players going into the trade deadline:

“I think Alex Caruso is one of the most valuable players in the NBA.I think you need to get a haul for him. Those players like DeMar DeRozan, like Alex Caruso just don't grow on trees.”

Billy Donovan on DeMar DeRozan, Alex Caruso, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Marc Eversley on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
[Bulls GM] Marc Eversley told the Athletic recently,

“I’d love DeMar to be part of the program long term.’ Where do things stand with any extension talks and your overall feeling on if you see the Bulls as a long-term fit? DeRozan: “That’s a place I want to be and end my career. I want to be able to accomplish everything I’ve set out to accomplish. That’s all I can worry about and control. I have the utmost confidence in myself. I’ll let my agent and the organization deal with that side of things, to be honest man. From their standpoint, they want me to be there long-term and vice versa. We’ll see what happens from there.”

Marc Eversley on DeMar DeRozan, Sep 28, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Marc Eversley on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
[Bulls GM] Marc Eversley told the Athletic recently,

“I’d love DeMar to be part of the program long term.’ Where do things stand with any extension talks and your overall feeling on if you see the Bulls as a long-term fit? DeMar DeRozan:“That’s a place I want to be and end my career. I want to be able to accomplish everything I’ve set out to accomplish. That’s all I can worry about and control. I have the utmost confidence in myself. I’ll let my agent and the organization deal with that side of things, to be honest man. From their standpoint, they want me to be there long-term and vice versa. We’ll see what happens from there.”

Marc Eversley on DeMar DeRozan, Sep 27, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Torrey Craig on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“Everybody knows two of the most talented scorers on the team with LaVine and DeRozan. Once those guys get it going, it’s pretty much a wrap. As a defender, I can give those guys tips and advice on what teams want to do and how they want to guard them and the insight I had playing against those guys to give them any edge they need.”

Torrey Craig on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Aug 21, 2023. Source: NBC Sports Chicago.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Love
item.description:
When Giannis made it to the NBA, he couldn’t even validate his own feelings in part because he didn’t know how.

“In 2017, 2018, DeMar DeRozan and Kevin Love came out public with what they were dealing with,”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Love, Apr 11, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: OG Anunoby on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:OG Anunoby on DeMar DeRozan's influence early in his career:

“DeMar was real nice to me. He was a good guy. He's still a great friend of mine. Just a great teammate. We all looked up to him and he did a good job teaching us.”

OG Anunoby on DeMar DeRozan, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Pat Bev said on his podcast.

“I’mma give him all the energy he needs. Destroy people. Me and DeMar DeRozan, we good. I got a popping five in Vucevic. I’m excited, I’m really excited.”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Nikola Vucevic, Feb 21, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Patrick Williams on matching up with Kevin Durant tonight:

“I definitely enjoy it. ... I always want to be able to look back and say I battled with KD, I battled with LeBron, I was playing on a team with DeMar DeRozan and Zach LaVine. You never know how much longer they have.”

Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Kevin Durant, Jan 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Grayson Allen
item.description:
LaVine on the DeRozan-Allen skirmish:

“We know his track record. Pat got the foul but DeMar got elbowed in the back of the head. DeMar responded the right way. The next 20 minutes, you saw what happened.”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Grayson Allen, Dec 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Casey on Bogey as potential All-Star:

“I hope people don’t look at our record as a rebuilding team & punish him. To me, Bogey’s an All-Star. I’ve coached a lot of offensive players in my career — Nowitzki, DeRozan, Kevin Garnett. Offensively, he’s right up there with those guys.”

Dwane Casey on Dirk Nowitzki, DeMar DeRozan, Kevin Garnett, Dec 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan poised to hit 20,000 points:

“I’ve said this before: I think DeMar DeRozan is a Hall of Famer.”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Oct 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Dalen Terry on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine
item.description:
Dalen Terry:

“I watched so much DeMar DeRozan this year... Zach LaVine, smoothest player ever.”

Dalen Terry on DeMar DeRozan, Zach LaVine, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Lonzo Ball on DeMar DeRozan:

“In one word, amazing. This is probably one of the best seasons he’s ever had. He’s like a big brother to me, especially being where I’m from. I always looked up to him and it’s just amazing to play alongside him and watch greatness.”

Lonzo Ball on DeMar DeRozan, Apr 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry, DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“If I look at the template of Kyle Lowry and DeMar DeRozan, they started (ascending when they were) 27, or around that time,”

Masai Ujiri on Kyle Lowry, DeMar DeRozan, Feb 12, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Chris Paul, DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Julia Poe:Billy Donovan on the off-court similarities between DeMar DeRozan and Chris Paul:

“I think both guys are students of the game. I think both guys love the game. I think both guys take time to invest in younger players.”

Billy Donovan on Chris Paul, DeMar DeRozan, Feb 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Gregg Popovich on former Spur DeMar DeRozan and what he's doing with the Bulls this season:

“It doesn't surprise me one iota. As you well know, he's a great guy, great teammate. He does what he does and he does it really well, and he's brought that to Chicago.”

Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
And the revamped roster is clicking to the point that Chicago can dream about not just avoiding the play-in morass, but challenging for home-court advantage in the first round.

“I’m always confident. I put the work in. But having [DeRozan] next to me, having Vooch next to me, Lonzo, that just makes me more confident and more ready to play,”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Dec 2, 2021. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
“But he’s good at leaning back and I hit his head a little bit. It’s a tough one, obviously. I wanted to be out there. Even with everything we had a chance to win the game. Doncic (29 points, seven assists) tied the score at 117 on a shot from the lane with 19.4 seconds left, setting up DeRozan’s heroics.“DeMar hit a huge shot,”

Kristaps Porzingis on DeMar DeRozan, Apr 12, 2021. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Derrick White on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:White on DeRozan delivering night in and night out:

“We've had a lot of different lineups, young guys coming in who haven’t really played much, and he was just steady the whole time, consistent,the DeMar that we have known since we have been in San Antonio.”

Derrick White on DeMar DeRozan, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
More from Murray on DeRozan:

“All-Star Game is nice and all, but you got no control over that. I am pretty sure he is upset at the moment. I talked to him. But he’s motivated. He is ready to get back with us and go prove everybody wrong.”

Dejounte Murray on DeMar DeRozan, Feb 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Pop on DeRozan's All-Star snub:

“I was disappointed he didn’t make it. I feel badly for him. He deserved to be on the All-Star team, in my opinion. He’s helped us win, put us in good position, he’s scored, he’s distributed the basketball, his leadership has been amazing.”

Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan, Feb 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan
item.description:
Pop on how DeMar DeRozan is doing after the death of his father:

“As well as anyone would expect when you lose a parent. It’s a difficult situation. But I’ve been in touch with him. He is very mature, kind man, and he is doing what he needs to do with his family right now.”

Gregg Popovich on DeMar DeRozan, Feb 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
